why: ब्रह्मणः is the regular genitive of ब्रह्मन्, agreeing with देवकृतस्य.
राधसि is a valid locative of राधस् after भजस्व.
सिन्धुर्ह is सिन्धुः + ह with regular visarga sandhi.
सिन्धुम् is the regular accusative, object of अव.
शुचिभ्यः is a regular dative plural of शुचि.
जनामि is a regular 1st-person present with object सुष्टुतिम्.
राधस्ते is राधः + ते with regular sandhi; दस्यवे वृक is a name.
रयिर्वि is रयिः + वि (विराजति) with regular sandhi.
पवमानस्या गत is पवमानस्य + आ गत, regular sandhi.
रोदसीमे is रोदसी + इमे, regular sandhi.
रजस is रजसः before vowel-initial इन्द्र, regular visarga drop.
सहस्राद् is a regular ablative before रिरिचे.
दक्षिणे is a regular locative agreeing with हस्ते.
दक्षिणाभिः is a regular instrumental plural.
सुन्वति दक्षिणावति are regular locatives agreeing with यजमाने.
पवित्र is पवित्रे before उपरि with regular sandhi; accent fits the following anudatta.
सहस्राप्साः is a regular compound (सहस्र + अप्सस्), fits the metre.
गुहाविः is गुहा + आविः, regular sandhi.
मदेरू is one of the rare words of this hymn, matching the surrounding dual forms.
दक्षिणां is a regular accusative, object of दुहते.
ऊतयः with anudatta on the last syllable before udatta सन्ति is correct accent practice.
नमस्ते is नमः + ते with regular sandhi.
आ गत is a regular 2nd-person plural imperative; the vocatives are plural.
गोमती is a regular feminine agreeing with सूनृता and मही.
परमेष्वा is परमेषु + आ, regular sandhi, parallel to मध्यमेषु.
वामवसे is वाम् + अवसे, regular sandhi.
परमाः is a regular nominative plural agreeing with नियुतः.
सदसः is a regular ablative agreeing with सोम्यात्.
सदनी is a regular feminine form parallel to अपिप्राणी.
मदमा गहि is मदम् + आ गहि, regular sandhi.
अपिबः is a regular imperfect 2nd person.
परशुं is a regular accusative agreeing with तिग्मम्.
सदश्वः is a regular compound parallel to सुवीरः.
सदथः is a regular 2nd dual present after the dual vocatives.
सदस is सदसः before vowel-initial एवयामरुत्, regular sandhi.
मदन् is a regular 3rd plural injunctive with subject देवाः.
सदस्य is सत् + अस्य, regular sandhi, repeated in the same line.
गोमता is a regular instrumental agreeing with रथेन.
सदतं is a regular 2nd dual imperative after इन्द्रवायू.
मरुतस्ताँ is मरुतः + तान् with regular sandhi.
गोमन्नः is गोमत् + नः with regular sandhi.
गोमते is a regular dative agreeing with वाजाय.
गोमन्न is गोमत् + नः before vowel, regular sandhi.
सदन्तः is a regular participle agreeing with परिषद्वानः.
मर्त्यासु is a regular locative plural agreeing with विक्षु.
परमां is a regular accusative agreeing with परावतम्.
बृहन् is the regular nominative masculine agreeing with क्रतुः.
विप्रासः is a regular Vedic nominative plural.
बृहदा is बृहत् + आ, regular sandhi.
शवस is शवसः before vowel-initial उत्सवेषु, regular sandhi.
पवते is a regular 3rd singular present with subject हरिः.
पृथिव्याम् is a regular locative.
भूरिभिः is a regular instrumental plural agreeing with ऋषिभिः.
पवत is पवते before vowel-initial आयवे, regular sandhi.
पवस्वा is the edition's lengthened imperative before सहस्रजित्, a known Vedic form.
पवसे is a regular 2nd singular middle present.
वृत्राणि with anudatta on the last syllable before udatta जङ् is correct accent practice.
सरस्वति is a regular vocative with short final.
अपसा is a regular instrumental of अपस्.
सोमानां is a regular genitive plural.
